description: This file defines the SugarFieldPhone class, which extends SugarFieldBase, providing a specialized implementation for handling phone fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes a save method to assign phone field values from input parameters to the bean object.

classes.name: SugarFieldPhone
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase to handle phone-specific logic in the CRM, with an overridden save method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Called when a bean is saved; assigns the phone field value from parameters to the bean object.
